inputs.original_text: Tom Homan isn’t ruling out immigration enforcement at polling places, and he’s right to ask what Democrats are afraid of. A lawful election should have nothing to hide from ordinary enforcement of the law. The administration’s mixed answers have created needless confusion, but protecting the integrity of the vote and upholding the rule of law should not be treated as partisan offenses.
inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan hasn’t ruled out immigration enforcement at polling places, and the real question is why Democrats seem so alarmed by the possibility that the law will be enforced. Voting should be orderly and lawful; no one should be above ordinary enforcement simply because an election is underway. The administration’s mixed messages have caused confusion, but that is no reason to make election integrity and the rule of law taboo.
